Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Delhi gasps as funds to combat pollution lowered
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026-27 has reduced pollution control funding by Rs 209 crore, sparking criticism amid Delhi-NCR's severe air quality crisis. The cutback has raised concerns about tackling the escalating public health emergency, with experts lamenting the lack of regional focus and inadequate support for key initiatives. The reduced funding contrasts with increased allocations for clean energy, highlighting the need for more targeted support for pollution control efforts.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget raises funds for Delhi’s central hospitals; AIIMS gets Rs 5,500 crore
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026-27 has increased funding for major Delhi government hospitals, including AIIMS New Delhi, which will receive Rs 5,500 crore. The budget boost aims to enhance tertiary care, medical education, and patient services at hospitals such as Safdarjung, RML, and Lady Hardinge Medical College. This increased funding will help sustain patient inflow and upgrade infrastructure at these central hospitals.

Policies and Initiatives.title: The name’s bond: Union Budget gives Delhi MCD another shot at fund-raising
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget has offered the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) a chance to re-enter the bond market with a Rs 100 crore incentive for municipal bonds exceeding Rs 1,000 crore. The MCD's previous attempts to issue bonds in 2012 and 2017 were unsuccessful due to trifurcation and delayed approvals. This new incentive provides the MCD with another opportunity for fund-raising.

Policies and Initiatives.title: As Delhi-Meerut RRTS wraps up, NCRTC sees Rs 700-crore dip in Union Budget. Here’s why
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) has seen a Rs 700-crore reduction in the Union Budget. This decrease comes as the Delhi-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) project nears completion. The reduced allocation is likely due to the project's progressing stage, requiring less funding.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 4.78% more funds for Delhi Police in Union Budget 2026-27, eye on modernisation
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026-27 has allocated 4.78% more funds to the Delhi Police. The increased funding is intended to support the modernisation of the police force. The budget aims to enhance the capabilities and resources of the Delhi Police.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Mixed bag: Union Budget 2026-27 leaves traders in Delhi divided
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026-27 has received a mixed reaction from traders in Delhi, with some expressing satisfaction and others disappointment. The budget's impact on traders is divided, with no clear consensus on its overall effect. Traders in Delhi are weighing the budget's provisions and their potential consequences for their businesses.

Policies and Initiatives.title: CM Rekha hails Budget, terms it people-centric
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Delhi's Chief Minister welcomed the Union Budget 2026-27, praising its focus on economic growth and citizen well-being. The budget prioritizes key groups including farmers, youth, women, and infrastructure development, such as the Delhi-Varanasi high-speed rail. Former CM Kejriwal criticized the budget for not addressing loan waivers, unemployment, and inflation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget allocation for Delhi unchanged at Rs 1,348 cr
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The 2026-27 Union Budget allocates Rs 1,348 crore to Delhi, unchanged from the previous year. The funds will be used for various purposes including water infrastructure, disaster relief, and compensation for 1984 riot victims. A high-speed rail corridor between Delhi and Varanasi is also planned as part of the budget.

Policies and Initiatives.title: A people-first, future-ready Budget: Assembly Speaker
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Delhi Assembly Speaker Vijender Gupta praised the Union Budget 2026-27 for its focus on self-reliance, inclusive growth, and infrastructure development. The Budget includes record capital expenditure, support for MSMEs, and initiatives for farmers, women, and social infrastructure. It reflects Prime Minister Modi's vision for a developed India by 2047.

Policies and Initiatives.title: In face-recognition first, Delhi Police personnel to wear AI smart glasses in R-Day crime fight
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Delhi Police personnel will wear AI smart glasses equipped with face-recognition technology to enhance security during the Republic Day celebrations. This initiative marks a first in the use of AI-powered smart glasses for face recognition in law enforcement. The smart glasses aim to help police identify and prevent potential crimes.

Policies and Initiatives.title: HCLTech Partners With Carahsoft To Drive IT Efficiencies in US Public Sector
Policies and Initiatives.summary: HCLTech has partnered with Carahsoft to drive IT efficiencies in the US public sector. Additionally, HCLTech has also partnered with Team Global Express to digitize multimodal logistics using AI. These partnerships aim to leverage technology to improve operations and efficiency.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Salman Khan gets Delhi HC notice: Chinese AI app files plea over order on personality rights
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Delhi High Court has issued a notice to Salman Khan in response to a plea by a Chinese AI app seeking to overturn an interim injunction granting Khan personality rights. The AI platform claims the order negatively impacts its operations. Khan has been directed to file a reply to the plea within four weeks.

Policies and Initiatives.title: WEF Davos: Karnataka holds talks with Bharti, PayPal, Mistral AI on expansion
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka held talks with companies like Bharti, PayPal, and Mistral AI at WEF Davos to discuss expansion opportunities. The state pitched investment opportunities in areas such as data centres and AI hubs. Deputy CM Shivakumar promoted Bengaluru as the "city of the future" to attract international investment.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Tagbin’s Immersive Media Platform Finds Enterprise Niche In The AI Age
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Tagbin, an immersive technology and AI startup, has found a niche in the enterprise sector with its innovative platform. The company has worked on notable projects, including designing a virtual statue of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose. Tagbin's platform utilizes immersive media to create engaging experiences, catering to the growing demand for interactive technologies in the enterprise space.

Events.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman likely to visit India in Feb: ChatGPT maker expected at India AI Impact Summit 2026 - What we know so far
Events.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is expected to visit India in mid-February for the India AI Impact Summit. The summit is scheduled to take place from February 16-20, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. Altman's visit is anticipated to be a key part of the event, which will focus on the impact of AI in various sectors.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit next month, PWD to beautify Delhi
Events.summary: The AI Impact Summit is scheduled to take place next month, although details about the event are scarce. Meanwhile, the Public Works Department (PWD) has announced plans to beautify Delhi. The connection between the AI summit and the PWD's beautification project is not specified in the available information.

Major AI Developments.title: Budget 2026: What decides states’ share of central taxes — and how the formula has changed over time
Major AI Developments.summary: Finance Commissions have revised the formula for states' share of central taxes, shifting focus from population and poverty to factors like fiscal capacity, demographic performance, and GDP contribution. The weight of income distance has decreased, while new measures have been introduced to balance equity and efficiency in resource allocation. The revised formula aims to reflect a more nuanced approach to distributing central taxes among states.

Major AI Developments.title: Budget 2026: Delhi's kitty stays intact at Rs 1,348 cr; funds for water, disaster relief and high-speed rail
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi's Union Budget allocation remains steady at Rs 1,348 crore, with Rs 951 crore in central assistance and Rs 380 crore for the Chandrawal water treatment plant. The budget also provides grants for 1984 anti-Sikh riots victims and disaster response. The allocation aims to boost infrastructure, employment, and various sectors in Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi man critical after taking HIV preventive drugs on AI advice
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi man is in critical condition after taking HIV preventive drugs without a prescription, based on advice from an AI chatbot. The medication led to a rare and serious condition called Stevens-Johnson syndrome. The incident highlights the risks of relying on AI advice for medical decisions without consulting a healthcare professional.

Major AI Developments.title: AI and unstructured data: A roadmap for India's digital transformation with elastic CEO
Major AI Developments.summary: Elastic CEO discusses India's digital transformation roadmap, focusing on AI and unstructured data. The conversation highlights the importance of leveraging AI to extract insights from unstructured data, driving business growth and innovation. India's digital transformation is expected to be fueled by effective management and utilization of this data.

Major AI Developments.title: CBDT awards ₹3000 crore contract to LTIMindtree for building AI-powered tax analytics platform
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has awarded a ₹3000 crore contract to LTIMindtree for developing an AI-powered tax analytics platform. The platform aims to enhance the Income Tax Department's analytical capabilities, enabling faster and more data-driven decision-making. This project is expected to significantly improve the department's overall efficiency.

AI Start-Up News.title: 1Buy.AI raises Rs 32.5 Cr in seed round led by 100Unicorns
AI Start-Up News.summary: 1Buy.AI, a procurement and cost-reduction platform, has raised Rs 32.5 crore in a seed funding round led by 100Unicorns. The funding round also saw participation from investors such as Ashish Kacholia, Gruhas, and FJ Labs. The fresh funds will be used to accelerate the development of the company's SaaS platforms and expand its global data pipes.
